name: WisdomTwin
description: A private business twin for one role on the org chart. Slack is live. Gmail and Google Drive are coming soon. Every answer carries a citation from that role's index.

gmail.availability: Off until Google verification clears. Flip GMAIL_CONNECTOR_ENABLED without a code change.

drive.availability: Off until Google verification clears. Flip DRIVE_CONNECTOR_ENABLED without a code change.

tools.name: connect_business_account
tools.description: Validate a business domain, open the current tenure for a role title, and return a read-only OAuth URL.

tools.name: ingest_data
tools.description: Fetch, chunk, and embed business communications into the role namespace.

tools.name: query_twin
tools.description: Answer from the role index and attach a citation to every claim.

tools.name: list_twins_status
tools.description: List connected role twins with chunk counts, last update, and domain.

auth.mcp: OAuth authorization-server endpoints from the Python MCP SDK, with PKCE for the public client.

connectors.slack: Authorization code with PKCE and read-only user scopes.
connectors.gmail: Authorization code with PKCE and gmail.readonly, testing mode.
connectors.drive: Authorization code with PKCE and drive.readonly, testing mode.

pricing.wisdomtwin_pro: USD 20 per month, billed by WisdomTwin Inc through WisdomTwin checkout
